offers.label: $35 credit for moving to a 1-year contract

assumption_register.label: Save rate of the standard offer
assumption_register.rationale: Share of would-be churners kept by the offer. Profit-based churn studies use a mean acceptance of 30%; we take 20% because proactive contact can backfire and high-risk customers are not always responsive.

assumption_register.label: Offer cost (multiplier on catalog cost)
assumption_register.rationale: Standard offer is a one-time $20 credit, about 30% of the $64.76 average monthly bill and about 8% of the average customer value; published loyalty discounts run around 10% of the bill per month.
assumption_register.validate_by: Finance sign-off of the offer budget

assumption_register.label: Contact cost per customer (USD)
assumption_register.rationale: One outbound retention call plus SMS follow-up. Live-agent contacts average US$8.01; profit-metric studies use about 0.5% of customer value; SMS costs cents.

assumption_register.label: Contribution margin
assumption_register.rationale: Share of the monthly bill kept as contribution. US telecom EBITDA margins are 35-42% and gross margins about 60%, so 30% is deliberately conservative.

assumption_register.label: Value horizon (months)
assumption_register.rationale: Months of margin a saved customer is expected to stay. One contract year, scaled 0.75/1.0/1.25 by tenure, because a saved would-be churner is likely to churn again sooner than an average customer.
assumption_register.validate_by: Survival of pilot customers after 6 and 12 months

assumption_register.label: Annual discount rate
assumption_register.rationale: US telecom cost of capital is about 5.4%; adding Vietnam's 3.9% country risk premium gives about 10%.

model.label: Logistic Regression
model.selection_rule: AP within 0.01 of best calibrated candidate; Brier within 0.002 of best; prefer simpler

strategy_selection.rule: segment_offers only if it beats ev by >= 5% on validation

optimistic.overrides_text: save rate 30%, offer cost x0.75, contact cost $2, margin 40%, value horizon 15 months

threshold_rules.rule: Expected value, ranked within the fixed budget

pilot.decision_rule: go if the 95% interval of q is above 0 and q >= break-even; stop if q <= 0 or the interval is below break-even; otherwise extend
